claims.claim: 突发、持续不缓解的胸部疼痛或不适提示可能为心脏病发作，须立即呼叫急救（英国指引为 999；中国场景对应急救电话）。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain - NHS
claims.supportQuote: you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away – the pain can feel like squeezing or pressure inside your chest, burning or indigestion … You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.
claims.applicability: 患者层面急救行动边界；急救号码在英国为 999，在中国场景对应 120
claims.uncertainty: NHS 为英国官方患者指引，急救号码为 999；120 为本报告对中国急救号码的本地化表述，原文未载该数字，属不可核验引文。

claims.claim: 急性胸痛原因众多，多数并非心脏问题，不应仅凭症状自我诊断。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain - NHS
claims.supportQuote: Chest pain has many different causes. In most cases, chest pain is not caused by a heart problem.
claims.applicability: 急性胸痛病因鉴别与症状学局限
claims.uncertainty: 属症状学一般性描述，不替代急诊客观检查

claims.claim: 舌下硝酸甘油自救的升级规则：必要时每 5 分钟重复一次，15 分钟内最大总量不超过 1.2 mg；在此时间窗内症状不缓解应即刻寻求医疗救助。
claims.sourceTitle: Role of short-acting nitroglycerin in the management of ischemic heart disease
claims.supportQuote: If additional doses are necessary, they should be taken at 5-minute intervals for a maximum dose of ≤1.2 mg within 15 minutes. During this timeframe, if relief does not occur, the patient should seek immediate medical attention. … take sublingual nitroglycerin (0.3 to 0.6 mg) every 5 minutes until the pain subsides or a maximum of 1.2 mg has been taken within 15 minutes
claims.applicability: 稳定型缺血性心脏病/心绞痛患者的自救用法与升级触发（经同行评议综述转述的 ESC 2013 SCAD 与 ACCF/AHA 2012 SIHD 指南内容）
claims.uncertainty: 该规则来自指南与综述转述，非针对阈值本身的随机试验验证

claims.claim: 对舌下硝酸甘油无反应的发作常规定义为：连续三次（每 5 分钟一次）短效硝酸酯后胸痛无改善，应视为可能的急性心肌梗死，需立即医疗评估。
claims.sourceTitle: Role of short-acting nitroglycerin in the management of ischemic heart disease
claims.supportQuote: an angina attack that does not respond to short-acting nitroglycerin (generally defined as a lack of improvement in chest discomfort following up to three short-acting nitrates every 5 minutes) should be regarded as consistent with a possible acute MI requiring immediate medical attention and evaluation.
claims.applicability: 心绞痛发作自救失败的升级触发定义
claims.uncertainty: 为指南与文献中的操作性定义，未检索到直接随机试验验证

claims.claim: 舌下硝酸甘油用于稳定型缺血性心脏病即时缓解心绞痛为 I 类推荐、B 级证据；其定位是症状缓解治疗，而非把'缓解与否'用作诊断试验。
claims.sourceTitle: Role of short-acting nitroglycerin in the management of ischemic heart disease
claims.supportQuote: In SIHD patients, sublingual nitroglycerin tablets or spray are recommended for immediate relief of angina (Class I, Level of Evidence, B).
claims.applicability: 已诊断冠心病/心绞痛人群的发作期症状缓解
claims.uncertainty: 推荐等级针对症状缓解治疗；'不作诊断试验'为据此与相关指南记录作出的推理结论

claims.claim: 多数患者含服 0.3–0.6 mg 舌下硝酸甘油后 5 分钟内症状缓解——这是'5 分钟间隔'设定的药效学基础，而非试验验证的升级截点。
claims.sourceTitle: Role of short-acting nitroglycerin in the management of ischemic heart disease
claims.supportQuote: Most patients respond within 5 minutes of taking one to two sublingual dose(s) of 0.3–0.6 mg each.
claims.applicability: 硝酸甘油起效时间与 5 分钟间隔设定的药效学依据
claims.uncertainty: '5 分钟内缓解'是药效学描述，不能作为诊断或排除心脏病的依据

claims.claim: 硝酸甘油通过降低心肌耗氧（降低前负荷、收缩期室壁应力与后负荷）并扩张冠状动脉等机制缓解缺血性心绞痛症状。
claims.sourceTitle: Role of short-acting nitroglycerin in the management of ischemic heart disease
claims.supportQuote: Nitroglycerin alleviates anginal symptoms by decreasing myocardial oxygen consumption as a function of: 1) reducing preload, systolic wall stress, and afterload
claims.applicability: 硝酸甘油缓解缺血性症状的病理生理机制
claims.uncertainty: 机制层面证据，不直接等同于症状缓解对病因的诊断价值

claims.claim: 症状发作至院内诊断时间与 30 天全因死亡独立相关（ISACS-TC 注册研究，6022 例 STEMI）：48 小时内就诊患者中每延长 1 小时，死亡 OR 1.02（95% CI 1.01–1.03）。
claims.sourceTitle: Delayed Care and Mortality Among Women and Men With Myocardial Infarction
claims.supportQuote: We identified 6022 STEMI patients who had information on time of symptom onset to time of hospital presentation at 41 hospitals participating in the ISACS‐TC (International Survey of Acute Coronary Syndromes in Transitional Countries) registry (NCT01218776) from October 2010 through April 2016. … We estimated the 30‐day risk of all‐cause mortality in each cohort. … In multivariable analysis adjusted for other predictors of mortality, time from symptom onset to in‐hospital diagnosis was independently associated with mortality in patients presenting to the hospital within 48 hours (OR of 1.02 [95% CI, 1.01–1.03] per 1‐hour delay
claims.applicability: '时间就是心肌'的观察性定量证据（ISACS-TC 注册研究，6022 例 STEMI）
claims.uncertainty: 观察性研究，效应量针对 48 小时内就诊亚组，存在残余混杂

claims.claim: 症状至就诊 ≤1 小时者相对 >12 小时者的 30 天死亡 OR 为 0.30（95% CI 0.20–0.44）。
claims.sourceTitle: Delayed Care and Mortality Among Women and Men With Myocardial Infarction
claims.supportQuote: We estimated the 30‐day risk of all‐cause mortality in each cohort. … patients with a time to presentation ≤1 hour had an OR of 0.30 (95% CI, 0.20–0.44) compared with the reference group of patients with a time to presentation >12 hours
claims.applicability: 尽早就诊（≤1 小时）相对显著延迟（>12 小时）的死亡风险差异
claims.uncertainty: 观察性注册研究，时间延迟队列分层

claims.claim: 女性 STEMI 患者症状发作至医院就诊的中位时间（270 分钟）长于男性（240 分钟）。
claims.sourceTitle: Delayed Care and Mortality Among Women and Men With Myocardial Infarction
claims.supportQuote: the overall time from symptom onset to hospital presentation was longer for women than men (median: 270 minutes [range: 130–776] versus 240 minutes [range: 120–600])
claims.applicability: 女性非典型症状与院前延迟（中国场景同样适用的人群层面发现）
claims.uncertainty: ISACS-TC 为 12 国转型经济体注册研究，人群代表性有限

claims.claim: 中国 101 家非 PCI 医院 7312 例 STEMI 患者中，院前延迟（症状至到达 >120 分钟）率 67.1%，首份心电图延迟率 31.4%，溶栓延迟率 85.8%，院内延迟率 67.8%。
claims.sourceTitle: Prehospital and in-hospital delays to care and associated factors in patients with STEMI: an observational study in 101 non-PCI hospitals in China
claims.supportQuote: The rates of prehospital delay, first ECG delay, thrombolytic therapy delay and in-hospital delay were 67.1%, 31.4%, 85.8% and 67.8%, respectively. … we had 7312 patients analysed with complete data … Prehospital delay was defined as the time from symptoms onset to hospital arrival (symptoms onset-to-hospital arrival time)>120 min.
claims.applicability: 中国基层（非 PCI）医院 STEMI 救治延迟现状
claims.uncertainty: CPACS-3 研究（2011–2014 数据），基层医院场景

claims.claim: 按 ESC/ACC 标准，院内首份心电图应在患者到达后 10 分钟内完成（到达至心电图 >10 分钟即视为延误）。
claims.sourceTitle: Prehospital and in-hospital delays to care and associated factors in patients with STEMI: an observational study in 101 non-PCI hospitals in China
claims.supportQuote: the first ECG delay was defined as the time from patient’s arrival at hospital to the time the patient had the first ECG done (hospital arrival-to-ECG time) >10 min
claims.applicability: 急诊 12 导联心电图时间目标（到达后 10 分钟内）
claims.uncertainty: 定义依据 ESC/ACC 指南与既往研究标准

claims.claim: 中国非 PCI 医院 STEMI 患者症状发作至到达医院的中位时间约 210 分钟。
claims.sourceTitle: Prehospital and in-hospital delays to care and associated factors in patients with STEMI: an observational study in 101 non-PCI hospitals in China
claims.supportQuote: the median time found in our study was much longer, about 210 min
claims.applicability: 中国基层医院 STEMI 院前延迟的量级
claims.uncertainty: 样本来自 101 家非 PCI 医院，不代表大型胸痛中心

claims.claim: 院前延迟与首份心电图延迟分别使患者接受溶栓治疗的机会降低 32% 与 28%。
claims.sourceTitle: Prehospital and in-hospital delays to care and associated factors in patients with STEMI: an observational study in 101 non-PCI hospitals in China
claims.supportQuote: prehospital delay and first ECG delay separately linked to 32% and 28% reductions of receiving thrombolytic therapy among our patients
claims.applicability: 院前延迟削弱再灌注机会（中国基层场景）
claims.uncertainty: 观察性关联，校正后估计

claims.claim: 欧洲心脏病学会（ESC）推荐 STEMI 确诊到开始溶栓的时间不超过 10 分钟。
claims.sourceTitle: Prehospital and in-hospital delays to care and associated factors in patients with STEMI: an observational study in 101 non-PCI hospitals in China
claims.supportQuote: the European Society of Cardiology recommended the time from STEMI diagnosis to the start of fibrinolysis to be within 10 min
claims.applicability: 再灌注时间目标（诊断至溶栓 ≤10 分钟）
claims.uncertainty: 为 ESC 2017 STEMI 指南目标的转述，中国基层达成率低

claims.claim: 自我用药者首次医疗接触延迟（>2 小时）的可能性为其他人的 9.02 倍。
claims.sourceTitle: Correlates of Delayed Initial Contact to Emergency Services among Patients with Suspected ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction
claims.supportQuote: The primary outcome was the evaluation of patient-related delay >2 hours from the period of symptom onset to the patient's initial presentation to the emergency department. … We found that patients who self-medicated were 9.02 times more likely to delay FMC.
claims.applicability: 自我用药行为与延迟呼叫急救的关系（该研究'自我用药'含镇痛药、麻醉剂、酒精、非法药物等，不含发病后含服硝酸甘油）
claims.uncertainty: 单中心回顾性研究（287 例 STEMI）；'自我用药'定义未包含硝酸甘油，外推需谨慎

claims.claim: 研究以症状发作后 2 小时作为延迟截点，因再灌注的获益主要发生在症状发作后的前 2 小时内。
claims.sourceTitle: Correlates of Delayed Initial Contact to Emergency Services among Patients with Suspected ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction
claims.supportQuote: The time of >2 hours was designated as the cutoff due to this time frame being found in other studies as the greatest considerable cause of morbidity and mortality, as the maximum benefit for coronary reperfusion would be within the first two hours after symptom initiation
claims.applicability: 院前延迟截点（>2 小时）与再灌注获益窗
claims.uncertainty: 基于既往研究设定的截点，非本研究的直接测量结局

claims.claim: 速效救心丸疗效荟萃分析纳入 41 项随机对照试验、共 6276 例冠心病患者。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The 41 studies consisted of 6276 patients with coronary heart disease.
claims.applicability: 速效救心丸疗效证据的规模
claims.uncertainty: 结局为心电图/血脂/血流变等慢性或发作缓解指标

claims.claim: 速效救心丸荟萃分析纳入的全部 41 项研究均在中国进行。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: All of the included studies were conducted in China. … The 41 studies consisted of 6276 patients with coronary heart disease.
claims.applicability: 速效救心丸证据的外推性
claims.uncertainty: 单一国家来源可能构成偏倚来源

claims.claim: 速效救心丸较对照显著改善心电图结果（RR 1.32，95% CI 1.26 至 1.38）；其荟萃结局为心电图/血脂等指标，不涉及自救场景下的升级时间阈值。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Administration of suxiao jiuxin pill significantly improved electrocardiogram (ECG) results when compared with other therapies (RR 1.32, 95% CI 1.26 to 1.38, and P < 0.001).
claims.applicability: 速效救心丸在冠心病（含心绞痛）人群的症状/心电图改善证据
claims.uncertainty: 不构成对院外急性胸痛自我分诊或升级时间阈值的证据

claims.claim: 速效救心丸荟萃分析中多数纳入研究因缺乏双盲设计 Jadad 评分低、方法学质量差。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Most of the clinical studies included in our meta-analysis were of poor quality based on their Jadad scores.
claims.applicability: 速效救心丸证据质量评价
claims.uncertainty: Jadad 评分为方法学代理指标

claims.claim: 速效救心丸最常见的不良反应为轻度头痛、头晕与面部潮红，多可自行缓解。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The most common symptoms were mild headache, dizziness, and facial flushing. Most of these symptoms resolved spontaneously.
claims.applicability: 速效救心丸不良反应特征
claims.uncertainty: 安全性数据来自质量参差的纳入研究，长期安全性证据有限

claims.claim: 多个观察性研究一致显示，症状发作至就诊/再灌注的时间延长与死亡率正相关（每 1 小时 OR 1.02，95% CI 1.01–1.03；中国注册数据同样显示院前延迟显著削弱再灌注机会），构成'时间就是心肌'的观察性定量证据。
claims.applicability: '时间就是心肌'的观察性定量证据链（ISACS-TC 与 CPACS-3 两个独立注册研究）
claims.uncertainty: 均为观察性证据；每 1 小时 OR 针对 48 小时内就诊亚组；未涉及对硝酸甘油自救阈值的直接检验

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Delayed Care and Mortality Among Women and Men With Myocardial Infarction
supportingSources.supportQuote: In multivariable analysis adjusted for other predictors of mortality, time from symptom onset to in‐hospital diagnosis was independently associated with mortality in patients presenting to the hospital within 48 hours (OR of 1.02 [95% CI, 1.01–1.03] per 1‐hour delay

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Prehospital and in-hospital delays to care and associated factors in patients with STEMI: an observational study in 101 non-PCI hospitals in China
supportingSources.supportQuote: Delay in each segment can lead to longer ischaemic time, which has been found to be associated with higher short-term as well as medium-term to long-term mortality in previous studies.

claims.claim: 硝酸甘油自救的'5 分钟间隔、15 分钟内 ≤1.2 mg、不缓解即升级'规则在多份指南与患者指引文本中一致，属于操作性/经验性设定；未检索到以随机试验直接验证该时间截点的证据。
claims.applicability: 指南阈值一致性及其证据形式的判断
claims.uncertainty: '未检索到随机试验'以本次检索覆盖范围为限；中国 2019 指南与 ESC 2023/AHA-ACC 指南为记录级访问，逐字条文待官方原文核验

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Role of short-acting nitroglycerin in the management of ischemic heart disease
supportingSources.supportQuote: take sublingual nitroglycerin (0.3 to 0.6 mg) every 5 minutes until the pain subsides or a maximum of 1.2 mg has been taken within 15 minutes
you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away … You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.

claims.claim: 自救用药不能替代呼叫急救：胸痛不缓解应即时呼叫急救（中国急救电话），任何自我用药（硝酸甘油、速效救心丸、镇痛药等）均不得成为延迟就医的理由。
claims.applicability: 急性胸痛安全边界：自救用药与呼叫 120 的相对位置
claims.uncertainty: 自我用药与延迟就医的关联证据来自回顾性研究且其'自我用药'定义未含发病后含服硝酸甘油；'立即呼叫急救'为指南/官方指引层面要求；120 为中国急救号码的本地化表述（NHS 原文为 999），该数字未见于支持来源，属不可核验引文。

supportingSources.supportQuote: you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away … You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Correlates of Delayed Initial Contact to Emergency Services among Patients with Suspected ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction
supportingSources.supportQuote: We found that patients who self-medicated were 9.02 times more likely to delay FMC.

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Role of short-acting nitroglycerin in the management of ischemic heart disease
supportingSources.supportQuote: During this timeframe, if relief does not occur, the patient should seek immediate medical attention.

claims.claim: 舌下硝酸甘油慎用于低血压（收缩压低于 100 mmHg）等情形，避免体位性低血压与反射性心动过速。
claims.sourceTitle: Role of short-acting nitroglycerin in the management of ischemic heart disease
claims.supportQuote: Caution is also warranted in administering sublingual nitroglycerin to patients with hypotension (or borderline systolic blood pressures of <100 mmHg)
claims.applicability: 硝酸甘油自救的安全边界（低血压、主动脉瓣狭窄、肥厚型心肌病等慎用）
claims.uncertainty: 为指南性安全警示转述，非对照试验数据

claims.claim: 指南文本对'硝酸甘油反应'的诊断价值存在分歧：ESC 稳定性冠心病指南（经综述转述）曾将'含服硝酸甘油不缓解'列为非心源性胸痛的描述性特征之一，而前瞻性研究不支持以缓解与否诊断心源性胸痛——缓解反应的诊断价值证据薄弱，临床不应据此分诊。
claims.sourceTitle: Role of short-acting nitroglycerin in the management of ischemic heart disease
claims.supportQuote: patients with pain that involves a small portion of the left hemithorax, lasts for several hours or even days, is not relieved by nitroglycerin, and may be provoked by palpation should be considered non-anginal pain (often musculoskeletal in origin)
claims.applicability: 硝酸甘油缓解反应诊断价值的指南表述分歧（稳定型心绞痛人群；不适用于急性未分化胸痛分诊）
claims.uncertainty: 该表述出自 ESC 2013 稳定性冠心病指南经综述的转述；前瞻性研究（Henrikson 等，题录级）与 2021 AHA/ACC 胸痛指南（记录级）不主张以缓解与否作诊断依据
